proposal: MONDAY (day-class B) catch-up cleanup - the downstream consumer of the corrected Friday + mid-week handoff
author: Specialist B (Monday weekend-information repricing / 06-10 ET catch-up window)
status: PROVISIONAL - proposed plays/amendments only; incumbents NOT edited; forward_evidence NONE (G17+ is the forward test)
premise: Greg: 'we get killed on Mondays' - and the wrecks are largely INHERITED ('we missed Monday because we missed Friday'). Quantified across G6-G16: blind Monday DIRECTION is wrong-signed on 11 of 22 Mondays; 10 of the 10 non-holiday wrong-sign Mondays are FRIDAY-ROOTED cascades that the CORRECTED Friday exit_type + monday_bias (specialist E) flip to the right sign. What remains after a clean inheritance is a Monday-NATIVE MAGNITUDE residual clustering into four buckets. These plays fix three of them; the fourth (fresh-shot gap size) is declared a data build.

consumes.from_friday_proposal (ng_brain_friday_pr: handoff_out fields exit_type + monday_bias + chain_age_sessions + last_hour_signed_flow + driver_realization; the weekend.carry_realization_flip verdict; the do-not-inherit-the-Friday-label structural fix.
consumes.from_midweek_proposal (ng_brain_midweek_: corrected_exit_read_protocol fields chain_polarity_and_age + conviction_verdict + exhaustion_state (Sunday/Friday close feeding the seam).

supporting_doc: scratchpad/monday_fix_summary.md (full per-Monday blind->corrected->rules table + the four residual buckets + unexplained days)
do_not_edit: ng_brain.json and all existing forecast/score/proposal files are untouched by this proposal.

proposed_plays.trigger: a carry-Monday (R3 carries the D-1 side, no fresh-shot gap) after the 06-10 catch-up carry, sizing the late-session ph2 depth
proposed_plays.read: the inherited SEAM chain-age carried across the overnight seam (E.handoff_out.chain_age_sessions / C.chain_polarity_and_age): the ph2 late-buy phase is ACCOMMODATED on a YOUNG chain (age<=2 -> price lifts, close OFF the low) or ABSORBED on a MATURE chain (age>=3 -> price still falls, close NEAR the low)
proposed_plays.call: young inherited chain -> size the day SHALLOW (close off-low, absorb_session False); mature inherited chain -> size the day DEEP (close near-low, absorb_session True). Chain-age is the LEADING indicator of the ph2 outcome and therefore of how deep the day pins - it calls it WITHOUT a book read. Demote the minute-grain imb_flow (a known Monday sampling artifact) to a diagnostic.
proposed_plays.evidence: MBO-PROVEN n=2 both scales on G15: 0316 age-1 down chain -> ph2 buy +959 ACCOMMODATED (+140 px) -> close off low 0.29 -> shallow -540 (my posterior -570, err -30); 0323 age-3 down chain cum-890 -> ph2 buy +2409 ABSORBED (price still -290) -> close near low 0.14 -> deep -1080 (my posterior -1080, err 0). Generalizes off G15: deepens 1117 (continuing mature down-chain absorbed -> -1510; corr -900 -> rule -1400) and confirms shallow priced carries (1124 +90).
proposed_plays.requires: chain age + polarity carried across the seam (open_time_only from E/C handoff); the ph2 accommodation/absorption fingerprint is MBO-measured for G15 only - all-Monday extension is a DATA build
proposed_plays.scope: carry-Monday day-move MAGNITUDE / close-off-extreme; does not set direction
proposed_plays.forward_evidence: NONE - proposed S104; G17+ is the forward test
proposed_plays.provenance: generalized from the G15 MBO round-2 specialist-B HE24->HE1 seam finding (forecasts/grp15_mbo_specialist_B_r2.json)
proposed_plays.caveats: Does NOT explain gap-driven Mondays (1027) or crash reactive tails (0202/0309 - the tail is beyond the accommodation/absorption band, reactive, not claimed at open). Overlaps incumbent monday.window_deep_book_shakeout: the seam chain-age is the decision-time-legit LEADING indicator of the SAME ph2 outcome that play's 06:00 L1-10 book read approximates - chain-age calls it in advance, the book confirms intra-window.

proposed_plays.trigger: a Monday whose overnight (ph0, ~20:00-06:00 ET) session prints a gap that does NOT confirm the inherited D-1 tilt (price drifts one way on flat-to-opposite signed flow)
proposed_plays.read: the overnight thin-book move vs its own flow: a gap on NON-CONFIRMING flow (sell-share <0.50 while price is up, or the signed-flow sign opposes the price move) is a HEAD-FAKE, not the day's direction. Gap SIGN is noise (E's do-not-inherit-the-label fix at the overnight scale).
proposed_plays.call: do NOT inherit the overnight gap sign. The 06-10 ET catch-up window is where the D-1 (Friday+Sunday) trade tilt reasserts; the head-fake REVERSES before/through the window into the ph1 carry. Direction stays with the inherited E.monday_bias, confirmed by the catch-up window's signed-flow-vs-price conviction.
proposed_plays.evidence: MBO-PROVEN n=2 on G15: 0316 overnight +490 to 02:21 on ph0 sflow -493 -> reversed -930 ph1 carry-down; 0323 overnight +1270 to 03:52 on ph0 sflow -26 -> reversed -1920 ph1 carry-down. Generalizes to the wrong-sign weekend-gap-up Mondays 1110/1117 (up gaps inherited, tape carried DOWN with the D-1 momentum) and 0302 (a warm-cut-DOWN gap that FAILED -> catch-up faded it UP).
proposed_plays.requires: overnight signed flow vs price (needs_intraday_reveal for the flow tell; MBO-measured for G15 only, archetype+curve inference elsewhere)
proposed_plays.scope: Monday direction gate at the 06-10 catch-up window
proposed_plays.forward_evidence: NONE - proposed S104; G17+ is the forward test
proposed_plays.caveats: A DIRECTION gate only - sizes nothing. Does not fix the fresh-shot gap MAGNITUDE (1027) - that is weekend_gap_delivery's data build. On a Monday whose overnight gap DOES confirm the D-1 tilt (fresh-shot cold add), the gap is real and this play does not fire (see the incumbent block_gap_ownership / weekend_gap_delivery).

proposed_plays.trigger: every non-holiday Monday, at the 06-10 ET catch-up window
proposed_plays.read: direction = the inherited D-1 (Friday+Sunday) trade tilt = E.monday_bias / C.conviction_verdict, NOT the gap sign or the Friday day-net. The catch-up window's own signed-flow-vs-price conviction CONFIRMS (ALIGNED) or FADES (a driver that realized over the weekend -> sell-the-news) that tilt.
proposed_plays.call: carry the inherited monday_bias through the window; if E.driver_realization says the driver realized over the weekend, the catch-up is a FADE (sell-the-news), not an extend. This is the Monday operationalization of the flow-is-the-primary-direction-gate finding (NG_FORECASTER_PROBLEM_MEMO_S103 sec 5/7): flow gates SIGN, the fundamental families set magnitude/where-it-can-go.
proposed_plays.evidence: carry-realization fades n>=2 (from E, spanning groups): 0223 (cold peak realized weekend -> catch-up faded -1790, corr+rule -1500); 0406 (cold-add realized ext-weekend -> faded -470, rule -450); 0309 (3-day up-run realized to warm crest -> catch-up faded -3020). Aligned carries: 0330 (positioning-spent expiry-covering -> resume pre-covering down -650); 0209 (roll-window-open carry down -830).
proposed_plays.requires: E.monday_bias + E.driver_realization (open_time_only) + the catch-up window conviction (needs_intraday_reveal for the live confirm)
proposed_plays.scope: Monday direction at the catch-up window; consumes the Friday/Sunday handoff, never the gap sign
proposed_plays.forward_evidence: NONE - proposed S104; G17+ is the forward test
proposed_plays.caveats: Direction/timing only. The sell-the-news FADE DEPTH on the crash days (0202/0309) is sized by seam_chainage + crash class but the extreme reactive tail is honest-under (not claimed at open). Sub-threshold cold (0406, HDD ~15.8) prices ONCE in the reopen gap then the tape reasserts - do not treat a sub-threshold shoulder cold add like a winter cold add.

proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.amendment: ADOPT E's proposed exit-state-inheritance clause AND add the intra-window mechanics R3 currently lacks. R3's read (fade mature-extreme gap / extend fresh-turn / carry Friday side) is keyed off the GAP; re-key it off the inherited E.exit_type + E.monday_bias (never the gap sign / Friday label - the 10 wrong-sign cascade Mondays), then apply INSIDE the 06-10 window: (a) monday.overnight_headfake_into_catchup screens the gap for a non-confirming head-fake; (b) monday.catchup_window_tilt_gate carries/fades the inherited tilt; (c) monday.seam_chainage_accommodation_gate sizes the ph2 depth. The 'often a REVERSAL' lean stays RETIRED - the apparent 'reversals' were the overnight head-fake reversing back to the D-1 tilt, not a day-level reversal.
proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.reason: R3 is correct in spirit but keyed off the wrong object (the gap). Keying it off the inherited Friday EXIT-STATE fixes the cascade cases (0202, 0223, 0309, 1110, 1117, 1201, 1215, 1222, 0105, 0406) where the gap sign alone mis-led Monday.

proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.amendment: record that the inherited SEAM chain-age (monday.seam_chainage_accommodation_gate) is a decision-time-legit LEADING indicator of the SAME ph2 accommodation-vs-absorption outcome this play approximates from the 06:00 L1-10 resting book. Chain-age calls the outcome IN ADVANCE (no book needed); the book read is the intra-window CONFIRM. They are complementary (STACK, never head-to-head): chain-age at the open + book at 06:00 + the intraday recruitment confirm this play already carries.
proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.reason: the play already found the 06:00 book approximates the caught/stacked side (6/7); the seam chain-age is the cheaper, earlier, open-time-legit version of the same read and closes the play's own 'Monday-specificity unproven / no open-time predictor' gap.

proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.amendment: record the Monday consumption rule: Monday reads E.handoff_out {exit_type, monday_bias, chain_age_sessions, driver_realization, last_hour_signed_flow} - STATE, never the Friday day-net or directional label. The 06-10 ET catch-up window is where Monday decides: screen the overnight gap for a head-fake, carry/fade the inherited tilt (catch-up_window_tilt_gate), size the ph2 depth by the inherited seam chain-age (seam_chainage_accommodation_gate). Direction stays with the D-1 (Friday+Sunday) trade tilt; the minute-grain imb_flow is a diagnostic only (Monday sampling artifact).
proposed_amendments_incumbents_untouched.reason: closes the enumeration of exactly what the Monday day-class consumes from the corrected Friday/mid-week handoff, consistent with the toolbag principle that only STATE survives the seam.
